meta.title: Web Clipper
meta.description: Copying a long page into a chat is tedious. Add the current page from the desktop sidebar browser as a sourced Markdown attachment, with a readable copy in a configurable folder. It only fills the composer and never sends.

tabMenu.label: Add to conversation
